summary: Maintain keyed agent activity timestamps without replaying activity history

replay.detail: Default readers and source capture are unchanged. Explicit registration maintains only affected activity categories and uses bounded reads; populated installation remains unavailable without complete capture.

schema.detail: Explicit activity View registration adds rebuildable local_agent_activity_rows and a partial local_agent_content_latest_index over content timeline sources. No default table/index installation or numeric core schema version change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or shared projection digest rule changes. Claims select by arrival position and local timeline by local ID, matching existing card activity semantics.

compatibility.detail: No client protocol, actor authorization or production reader change. Private dependency keys map to public agent IDs only after authorization in the caller snapshot.

downtime.detail: No default activation or startup work. This partial card dependency makes no deployed CPU or restart claim.

manual.detail: Default stores need no action. Claim/local/trim/prefix-promotion capture and complete card dependency certificates are required before explicit registration can serve public cards.

recovery.detail: Existing recovery paths are unchanged. Missing certification or a mutated/deleted claim returns unavailable. Derived rows are local rebuildable outputs, not authority evidence.
